observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: spacious wooden dance studio with tall windows and curtains in the background
observation.dancers: one couple, a man and a woman
observation.formation_and_space: couple dancing in closed and open partner hold, moving around the center of the dance floor
observation.posture: upright torso, erect posture with soft knees
observation.footwork: quick weight shifts and syncopated rhythmic steps matching the beat, cannot see exact heel-toe distribution due to distance and camera movement
observation.arms_and_hands: arms frame the couple, holding hands and leading turns, occasionally extended outward during spins
observation.hips_and_torso: fluid hip action and torso rotations corresponding to turns and dips
observation.partnering: close and open partner contact, frequent hand-holds, leading and following spins, underarm turns, and dips
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent spins and turns, low dips and body leans, no aerial jumps
observation.costume_and_props: man wears white dress shirt, tie, and brown trousers; woman wears black long-sleeve top and long orange skirt with side slit, with dance heels
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement details and ankle mechanics are obscured by long shots and camera angles

signature_moments.what: man leads woman into an underarm turn while traveling in a circle
man dips woman backward with supportive arm and leg extension
woman leans back into a low dip with leg swept outward held by partner
man lifts woman around his waist in a quick rotational support lift
final dip pose with woman extending one leg sideways while held close
